chunks: From him, from al-Naḍr, from Hishām, from Sulaymān ibn Khālid, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the two rakʿahs before al-fajr. He said: You perform them when the morning begins to brighten; indeed, they are before the morning prayer.

key_terms.الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ: the two rakʿahs referring to the recommended prayer before fajr
key_terms.الْغَدَاةِ: the morning, here referring to the fajr prayer time
key_terms.تُنَوِّرُ الْغَدَاةُ: when the morning begins to brighten
key_terms.قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ: before dawn, indicating the timing under discussion

ai.seo_question: When should the two rakʿahs before fajr be performed according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the time for the two rakʿahs of fajr. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام explains that they are performed when the morning begins to brighten, while still remaining before the obligatory morning prayer.
